name: skill-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for engineering work: the 9-step DDD Starter Modelling Process as a chained pipeline with a bundled diagram renderer, codebase priming and generated end-to-end suites, a game-development review board backed by cited rules, multi-agent fleet orchestration, and a toolkit of thinking and verification skills.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Understand a codebase, then verify it. core primes a repo once into a zero-token knowledge graph plus a CORE tree of CLAUDE.md contracts, so later questions cost a graph query instead of a file sweep. e2e-harness discovers a polyglot system from its own docs and generates runnable end-to-end suites across Node, Python, Go, C#, Rust, Kafka and Playwright.

plugins.name: ddd
plugins.description: The 9-step DDD Starter Modelling Process as a chained skill pipeline: understand, discover (EventStorming), decompose (bounded contexts), strategize (core domain chart), connect (message flows), organise (Team Topologies), define (Bounded Context Canvas), code (aggregates, hexagonal), contracts (JSON Schema payloads). Shares one ddd/ workspace with JSON schemas, validators and step gates; every step records its decisions with every option weighed and rebuilds a self-contained review page with SVG/PNG diagrams and decision comparisons, and the run ends with a blueprint final render. Node.js 18 or newer, nothing to install. Includes blueprint, the bundled diagram renderer (architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML) that `ddd export blueprint --deliver` uses and that can be used on its own.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: A review board for game work, backed by cited rules distilled from 38 game-development books: a studio CPO for any 'is this fun' question, plus focused auditors for systems, balance and economy, code architecture, performance and frame budget, and QA and ship-readiness.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run a herdr multi-agent worker fleet: an orchestrator that decomposes work, spawns and assigns workers by tier and integrates results through the horch CLI; the worker side of that protocol; and deterministic scripts for driving the herdr terminal workspace manager. Requires the herdr CLI (herdr.dev), which is not bundled.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Small cross-cutting skills: divergent ideation, human-sounding prose, spaced-repetition decks, model and subagent routing, an engineering persona, plan verification before and after implementation, and completion discipline for long autonomous runs. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see the plugin README.
